spans.s:
झणझण झणझण or झणझणा (an ono-
matopoetic word), the jingling or tinkling of orna-
ments; [cf. छनच्छन् and झलज्झला.]
—झण-
झणी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, rattling.

झणझणाय, nom. A. -यते, &c., to jingle,
tinkle.

झणत्कार झणत्-कार or झनत्-कार, अस्,
m. (fr. the imitative sound झणत् and कार), the
jingling, tinkling, or clinking of metallic ornaments.
